section_text_with_unit_anchors:
[v7u_N003726|3726] The World Economic Forum describes regulatory technology as the application of new technological solutions that assist highly regulated industry stakeholders in setting, effectuating, and meeting regulatory governance, reporting, compliance, and risk management obligations.
ZH: 世界经济论坛将监管技术定义为帮助受监管行业满足合规义务的新技术解决方案

[v7u_N003727|3727] According to FATF, the use of regulatory technology enhances compliance by enabling organizations to be more effective and efficient in managing financial crime risks.
ZH: FATF指出监管科技通过提高管理金融犯罪风险的效率和有效性来增强合规

[v7u_N003728|3728] Organizations use these technologies in executing various AFC controls, including customer onboarding, sanctions and negative news screening, and suspicious activity monitoring.
ZH: 组织在客户准入、制裁和负面新闻筛查、可疑活动监控等金融犯罪防控控制中应用监管科技

[v7u_N003729|3729] Digital onboarding uses technologies such as geolocation and device intelligence for remote identity verification, improving efficiency and security.
ZH: 数字开户利用地理位置和设备智能等技术进行远程身份验证，提升效率与安全性

[v7u_N003730|3730] Perpetual KYC ensures continuous risk monitoring.
ZH: 持续了解你的客户确保持续的风险监控

[v7u_N003731|3731] The Wolfsberg Group’s Guidance on Digital Customer Lifecycle Risk Management underscores secure non-face-to-face interactions and emphasizes ongoing, triggerbased due diligence.
ZH: 沃尔夫斯堡集团关于数字客户生命周期风险管理的指南强调安全的非面对面交互和持续的触发式尽职调查

[v7u_N003732|3732] Advanced screening tools employ AI to cross-reference customer data against global sanctions lists and adverse media sources. This enables institutions to swiftly identify and respond to potential risks associated with sanctioned parties and financial crime-related negative news.
ZH: 高级筛查工具利用AI将客户数据与全球制裁名单和负面媒体来源进行交叉比对

[v7u_N003733|3733] AI is enhancing traditional rules-based systems. These technologies can analyze vast datasets to detect complex and evolving patterns of suspicious behavior.
ZH: AI通过分析海量数据集检测复杂和不断变化的可疑行为模式，增强传统规则系统

[v7u_N003734|3734] Contextual monitoring further refines this process. It considers the broader context of transactions, such as customer behavior and market conditions, thereby reducing false positives and improving detection accuracy.
ZH: 情境监控考虑交易背景（如客户行为和市场状况），减少误报并提高检测准确性

[v7u_N003735|3735] The Wolfsberg Group’s highlights the role of transaction monitoring as one important factor, along with customer behavior and attributes, in detecting suspicious activity.
ZH: 沃尔夫斯堡集团强调交易监控与客户行为和属性共同构成检测可疑活动的重要因素

[v7u_N003736|3736] Advanced analytics and data visualization tools streamline investigations and due diligence, helping compliance teams efficiently detect, analyze, and mitigate financial crime risks.
ZH: 高级分析和数据可视化工具简化调查和尽职调查，帮助合规团队高效检测、分析和缓解金融犯罪风险

[v7u_N003737|3737] As technology advances to tackle complex problems, organizations should enhance their understanding, maintain data quality, and carefully implement solutions to minimize risk. Technology alone is not the solution—fundamentals always matter.
ZH: 技术虽能解决复杂问题，但组织需加强理解、保持数据质量并谨慎实施，基础始终重要

[v7u_N003738|3738] By adopting advanced technologies aligned with international standards, financial institutions can strengthen AFC frameworks and ensure effective crime prevention while maintaining regulatory compliance and ethical integrity.
ZH: 采用符合国际标准的先进技术可强化金融犯罪防控框架，确保有效预防犯罪并维护合规与诚信

[v7u_N003739|3739] When integrating technology into AFC compliance, organizations should align their systems with regulations in the jurisdictions in which they operate and have customers.
ZH: 将技术整合到金融犯罪防控合规中时，组织应使其系统符合运营和客户所在司法管辖区的法规

[v7u_N003740|3740] These regulations include stringent data and privacy laws, such as the GDPR in the EU and the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act in the US.
ZH: 示例：欧盟《通用数据保护条例》和美国GLBA等严格的数据和隐私法律

[v7u_N003741|3741] The FATF’s emphasizes policies for leveraging technology against financial crime.
ZH: FATF强调利用技术打击金融犯罪的政策

[v7u_N003742|3742] Additionally, the AML Act of 2020 in the US establishes a clear mandate for innovation as a key theme and purpose.
ZH: 美国2020年反洗钱法案明确将创新作为关键主题和目的

[v7u_N003743|3743] While there is no one-size-fits-all approach to AFC technology, each financial institution needs to implement appropriate technology along the customer journey.
ZH: 金融犯罪防控技术没有统一方法，各机构需根据客户旅程实施合适技术

[v7u_N003744|3744] During onboarding, financial institutions perform initial due diligence, which includes: KYC and identity and verification (ID&V); screening for sanctions and terror lists, PEPs, and adverse media; and completing a customer risk assessment and rating.
ZH: 客户准入时的初始尽职调查包括了解你的客户、身份验证、制裁与政治敏感人物筛查及风险评估

[v7u_N003745|3745] Based on the result of the risk rating, the organization may need to conduct enhanced due diligence (EDD).
ZH: 根据风险评级结果，机构可能需要进行强化尽职调查（EDD）

[v7u_N003746|3746] Financial institutions use technologies such as digital identity verification, biometric authentication, geolocation, and device intelligence to ensure secure and efficient KYC processes.
ZH: 金融机构使用数字身份验证、生物识别、地理位置和设备智能等技术确保了解你的客户安全高效

[v7u_N003747|3747] After onboarding, organizations perform ongoing due diligence, which may include periodic KYC or perpetual KYC.
ZH: 客户准入后，机构进行持续尽职调查，包括定期了解你的客户或持续了解你的客户

[v7u_N003748|3748] Periodic KYC involves updating customer information at fixed intervals, such as every one to five years, based on typical customer risks.
ZH: 定期了解你的客户指按固定间隔（如1至5年）更新客户信息

[v7u_N003749|3749] Perpetual KYC involves continuously monitoring customer profiles and detecting emerging risks in real time, such as changes in ownership structures, business activities, or adverse media coverage.
ZH: 持续了解你的客户指实时持续监控客户档案并检测新兴风险

[v7u_N003750|3750] Ongoing due diligence also includes transaction monitoring, payment and batch screening, and screening for sanctions, PEPs, and adverse media.
ZH: 持续尽职调查包括交易监控、支付与批次筛查以及制裁、政治敏感人物和负面媒体筛查

[v7u_N003751|3751] Realtime automated screening tools leverage machine learning and other forms of AI to cross-reference customer and transaction data with global sanctions lists, PEP databases, and global adverse media sources.
ZH: 实时自动化筛查工具利用机器学习和AI交叉比对客户与交易数据与全球制裁名单、政治敏感人物数据库和负面媒体来源

[v7u_N003752|3752] These tools ensure compliance with international regulations such as OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists.
ZH: 这些工具确保遵守OFAC、欧盟和联合国等国际制裁名单

[v7u_N003753|3753] They also help maintain oversight of customer risk and activity.
ZH: 这些工具还帮助维持对客户风险和活动的监督

[v7u_N003754|3754] Transaction monitoring technologies analyze transaction patterns in real time or on a scheduled basis using traditional rules-based systems, AI-based approaches, or both.
ZH: 交易监控技术使用传统规则系统、AI方法或两者结合实时或定期分析交易模式

[v7u_N003755|3755] Financial institutions analyze large datasets of customers, accounts, and transactions to identify anomalies, emerging financial crime trends, and contextual risk factors.
ZH: 金融机构分析客户、账户和交易的大数据集以识别异常、新兴金融犯罪趋势和情境风险因素

[v7u_N003756|3756] Financial crime investigation teams use intelligence-led and data visualization technologies to assist in the investigation of complex transaction flows.
ZH: 金融犯罪调查团队使用情报主导和数据可视化技术协助调查复杂交易流

[v7u_N003757|3757] AI-powered automation and external intelligence sources streamline manual processes, improving efficiency and accuracy in investigations.
ZH: AI驱动的自动化和外部情报源简化手动流程，提高调查效率和准确性

[v7u_N003758|3758] Comprehensive risk management frameworks incorporate predictive analytics, AI-driven risk scoring, and real-time data aggregation to proactively assess financial crime risks.
ZH: 全面风险管理框架整合预测分析、AI驱动风险评分和实时数据聚合以主动评估金融犯罪风险

[v7u_N003759|3759] Continuous monitoring and dynamic risk assessment help financial institutions adapt to emerging threats and regulatory changes.
ZH: 持续监控和动态风险评估帮助金融机构适应新兴威胁和监管变化

[v7u_N003760|3760] By integrating these technologies, financial institutions enhance their AFC compliance programs, strengthen risk management capabilities, and meet regulatory expectations while effectively mitigating and identifying financial crime risks.
ZH: 整合这些技术可增强金融犯罪防控合规计划、风险管理能力并满足监管期望

[v7u_N003761|3761] While many of these control functions are highly dependent on technology tools, organizations that have rushed to implement the latest technologies without appropriate risk assessment and understanding have had to suffer consequences. As cited in the Moneylaundering.com article, "Regtech Failures Plaguing European Banks," Carolin Gardner, the European Banking Authority’s head of AML, states, “One of the challenges, based on what (national) supervisors are telling us, is that technology is being employed before it’s properly tested, and that [it] then has the potential to actually weaken institutions’ systems and controls."
ZH: 未经充分风险评估即仓促部署新技术可能削弱机构内控体系

[v7u_N003762|3762] This article goes on to discuss how “unthinking” reliance on new technologies accounted for over half of the more than 250 cases in which financial services companies were found to have breached anti-money laundering rules in the EU in 2024.
ZH: 2024年欧盟超半数金融机构反洗钱违规源于对新技术的不加思考依赖

[v7u_N003763|3763] This article provides a good reminder that organizations need to follow the risk assessment fundamentals and sound technology implementation principles to gain advantages from innovative technology.
ZH: 机构应遵循风险评估基本原则和稳健技术实施原则以从创新技术中获益

units.knowledge_zh: 持续尽职调查包括交易监控、支付与批次筛查以及制裁、政治敏感人物和负面媒体筛查

units.en_quote: Realtime automated screening tools leverage machine learning and other forms of AI to cross-reference customer and transaction data with global sanctions lists, PEP databases, and global adverse media sources.
units.knowledge_zh: 实时自动化筛查工具利用机器学习和AI交叉比对客户与交易数据与全球制裁名单、政治敏感人物数据库和负面媒体来源

units.en_quote: These tools ensure compliance with international regulations such as OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists.
units.knowledge_zh: 这些工具确保遵守OFAC、欧盟和联合国等国际制裁名单

units.en_quote: They also help maintain oversight of customer risk and activity.
units.knowledge_zh: 这些工具还帮助维持对客户风险和活动的监督

units.en_quote: Transaction monitoring technologies analyze transaction patterns in real time or on a scheduled basis using traditional rules-based systems, AI-based approaches, or both.
units.knowledge_zh: 交易监控技术使用传统规则系统、AI方法或两者结合实时或定期分析交易模式

units.en_quote: Financial institutions analyze large datasets of customers, accounts, and transactions to identify anomalies, emerging financial crime trends, and contextual risk factors.
units.knowledge_zh: 金融机构分析客户、账户和交易的大数据集以识别异常、新兴金融犯罪趋势和情境风险因素

units.en_quote: Financial crime investigation teams use intelligence-led and data visualization technologies to assist in the investigation of complex transaction flows.
units.knowledge_zh: 金融犯罪调查团队使用情报主导和数据可视化技术协助调查复杂交易流

units.en_quote: AI-powered automation and external intelligence sources streamline manual processes, improving efficiency and accuracy in investigations.
units.knowledge_zh: AI驱动的自动化和外部情报源简化手动流程，提高调查效率和准确性

units.en_quote: Comprehensive risk management frameworks incorporate predictive analytics, AI-driven risk scoring, and real-time data aggregation to proactively assess financial crime risks.
units.knowledge_zh: 全面风险管理框架整合预测分析、AI驱动风险评分和实时数据聚合以主动评估金融犯罪风险

units.en_quote: Continuous monitoring and dynamic risk assessment help financial institutions adapt to emerging threats and regulatory changes.
units.knowledge_zh: 持续监控和动态风险评估帮助金融机构适应新兴威胁和监管变化

units.en_quote: By integrating these technologies, financial institutions enhance their AFC compliance programs, strengthen risk management capabilities, and meet regulatory expectations while effectively mitigating and identifying financial crime risks.
units.knowledge_zh: 整合这些技术可增强金融犯罪防控合规计划、风险管理能力并满足监管期望

units.en_quote: While many of these control functions are highly dependent on technology tools, organizations that have rushed to implement the latest technologies without appropriate risk assessment and understanding have had to suffer consequences. As cited in the Moneylaundering.com article, "Regtech Failures Plaguing European Banks," Carolin Gardner, the European Banking Authority’s head of AML, states, “One of the challenges, based on what (national) supervisors are telling us, is that technology is being employed before it’s properly tested, and that [it] then has the potential to actually weaken institutions’ systems and controls."
units.knowledge_zh: 未经充分风险评估即仓促部署新技术可能削弱机构内控体系

units.en_quote: This article goes on to discuss how “unthinking” reliance on new technologies accounted for over half of the more than 250 cases in which financial services companies were found to have breached anti-money laundering rules in the EU in 2024.
units.knowledge_zh: 2024年欧盟超半数金融机构反洗钱违规源于对新技术的不加思考依赖

units.en_quote: This article provides a good reminder that organizations need to follow the risk assessment fundamentals and sound technology implementation principles to gain advantages from innovative technology.
units.knowledge_zh: 机构应遵循风险评估基本原则和稳健技术实施原则以从创新技术中获益
